Privacy.title: Privacy and data
Privacy.description: What we keep and the choices you control.
Privacy.purpose: Your verified phone is kept for sign-in and security. Optional name, favorites, organization relationships and content you submit belong to your account.
Privacy.sharing: Your account phone is never shown in the public catalog. Optional name and biography are published only when you enable visibility. Staff and admins see information needed for their authorized role.
Privacy.ageRule: You must be at least {age, number} to use an account in this version. Age is self-declared; birth dates and identity documents are not collected.
Privacy.otpRetention: Up to {days, number} days after expiry. The readable code is never stored.
Privacy.sessionsRetention: Up to {days, number} days after expiry or revocation.
Privacy.invitationsRetention: Up to {days, number} days after invitation expiry.
Privacy.auditRetention: Up to {days, number} days, including time, action and operational reference.
Privacy.accountRetention: Data is kept while you use the account. Deletion has a {days, number}-day cancellation period; personal information and content are then removed from active data, leaving an unnamed operational reference.
Privacy.backupRetention: Backups, when made, are kept for at most {days, number} days. Restore must reapply processed account deletions.
Privacy.responsibilities: Owners and admins must resolve ownership or administrative responsibility with another account or an operator before deleting their account.
Privacy.scope: This policy covers the current account and catalog. Health, payment and training data need a separate policy before those services are enabled.
Privacy.acceptanceNotice: Confirm the data policy and minimum age in your profile before saving changes.
Privacy.pendingNotice: Account deletion is pending. Cancel the request before making changes.
Privacy.acceptPolicy: I have read and accept the data policy.
Privacy.confirmAge: I confirm I am at least {age, number}.
Privacy.marketing: I would like service announcements and offers.
Privacy.marketingHint: Optional. You can turn this off any time. Sign-in codes do not depend on this choice.
Privacy.accepted: The current policy and minimum age are confirmed.
Privacy.exportHint: Your export includes this account’s profile, favorites, roles and content. Credentials and other users’ information are excluded.
Privacy.pendingUntil: Deletion becomes eligible on {date}; you can cancel before processing.
Privacy.deleteHint: A recent sign-in is required. You have {days, number} days to cancel after requesting deletion.
Privacy.deleteConfirmation: After {days, number} days, your name, phone, favorites and content are removed and sessions end. You can cancel before processing.
Privacy.publicNameHint: Name appears on reviews; name and biography appear on club pages. Private by default.
Privacy.loginNotice: Your phone sends a sign-in code and creates or recovers your account. Read the data policy before continuing.
Privacy.confirmChoices: Confirm the data policy and minimum age.
Privacy.exportUnavailable: The file could not be saved or shared. Please try again.
